title: Scenario Based Sales Forecasting with Synthetic Evaluations
summary: A modular ML framework combining sales/profit forecasting with scenario-based simulation, augmenting a RandomForestRegressor's training data with synthetic future scenarios (bullwhip, overstock, supply disruption, market clash). SDV's CTGANSynthesizer is imported and fit on historical order/sales data via the sdv.single_table API to generate the synthetic scenario samples.
evidence: Synthetic Data 2022-23.ipynb:60-70: 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' ... 'synth = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata=metadata, epochs=500, verbose=True)\nsynth.fit(df)\nfake = synth.sample(1000)'
